check_in.title: Biometric check-in
check_in.intro: Face evidence at the gate. The gate always admits by the pass and the typed national ID.
check_in.failed_title: Could not read the biometric policy
check_in.failed_body: Nothing changes at the gate: admit by the pass and the typed national ID.

mode_body.OFF: No face evidence is captured at this agency.
mode_body.SHADOW: Face evidence is recorded for audit only. Nothing is shown here and no one is refused because of it.
mode_body.ADVISORY: Face evidence is shown as advice. The officer decides.

check_in.no_match: A face that does not match is never a refusal. Send the candidate to the supervisor for manual identity.

conflicts.title: Unresolved capture conflicts
conflicts.intro: Scores the server is holding because two captures disagree.
conflicts.none: No held scores on this tablet.
conflicts.no_permission_body: Resolving conflicts needs the conflict permission.
conflicts.metrics: Height {{height}} cm, weight {{weight}} kg, chest {{chest}} cm, run {{run}} s
conflicts.server_holds: The server keeps both captures until you resolve this.
conflicts.no_score_body: The server gave no score reference for this record.
conflicts.reason_required: Give a reason, up to {{max}} characters.

verdict.NOT_FOUND: No such application in your agency.
verdict.SCORE_NOT_FOUND: The application exists but that score does not.
verdict.NO_CONFLICT: There is no conflict to resolve.
verdict.FORBIDDEN: Your account may not resolve conflicts.
verdict.OTHER: The server did not resolve it.

verdict.PARTIALLY_SAVED: {{accepted}} saved, {{rejected}} REJECTED. The rejected records are not stored.
verdict.NONE_SAVED: NOTHING WAS SAVED. All {{rejected}} records were rejected: re-capture before leaving the venue.
verdict.EMPTY: The batch was empty. Nothing was sent.

biometric.invalid_invitation: This invitation cannot be accepted. Follow the manual verification procedure.
biometric.refuse: Do not admit. The biometric check did not pass.
biometric.wrong_agency: This invitation belongs to another agency.

conflict.resolution_label: Why you chose this capture (50 characters)

error.NOT_FOUND: No such application in your agency.
error.SCORE_NOT_FOUND: The application exists, but that capture does not.

ticket.label: Candidate pass (scan or type)
ticket.help: Scan the QR with the camera or a hand-held scanner.
ticket.unreadable: This is not a pass this system issued.
ticket.not_this_venue_title: This pass is not for this venue day
ticket.other_agency: The pass belongs to another agency.
ticket.other_day: The pass is for another exam day.
ticket.other_venue: The pass is for another venue.
ticket.no_venue_day: Confirm the venue and day on the setup page first.

setup.title: Device setup
setup.intro: Check the tablet, confirm the venue day and enrol the device before any station is used.
setup.blocked_body: Fix the blocked items above. Until then use the paper fallback: record on the paper sheet and enter it later.
setup.ready_body: This device can capture. Open a station from the station list.
setup.venue_help: Type the campaign code, district and exam date. The server confirms them.
setup.venue_not_found: No venue found for this campaign, district and date.
setup.venue_forbidden: Your account may not read this venue.
setup.venue_offline: No connection to the server. Try again.
setup.venue_other: The server could not confirm the venue. Try again.
setup.enrol_help: Enrolling sends only the public key. The private key never leaves this tablet.
setup.enrol_no_permission: Ask a screening officer or supervisor to enrol this device.
setup.enrol_revoked: This device was revoked and cannot be enrolled again.
setup.enrol_forbidden: Your account may not enrol devices.
setup.enrol_offline: No connection to the server. Try again.
setup.enrol_other: The server did not enrol the device. Try again.
setup.anchor_help: Optional. The slot key lets this tablet check a pass without a connection. It cannot admit anyone.
setup.anchor_invalid: This is not a valid key.
setup.runtime_failed_body: Secure storage or signing is not available in this browser. Use the paper fallback.

physical.title: Physical test
physical.intro: Scan the pass, enter the measurements. Each record is signed and the server must acknowledge it.
physical.blocked_body: This device is not ready. Use the paper sheet and finish setup.
physical.reason_label: Why this value stands (after measuring again)
physical.reason_help: Required when a value is outside the expected range.
physical.offline_body: Records are kept on this tablet but are NOT with the server. Write results on the paper sheet.
physical.duplicate_body: This exact record was sent before. Nothing was added.
physical.paper_prompt: Write the results on the paper sheet now. This record is only on this tablet.
physical.conflict_body: The server holds this score because another capture disagrees. A supervisor must resolve it.

reasons.AGENCY_MISMATCH: The candidate belongs to another agency.
reasons.TICKET_MISMATCH: The pass does not match the application.
reasons.NOT_ADMITTED: The candidate has not been admitted at the gate.
reasons.UNKNOWN: The server refused it for another reason.

physical.device_failed_title: This tablet could not save the record
physical.device_failed_body: Nothing was recorded or sent. Write the results on the paper sheet.

medical.title: Medical station
medical.intro_BOARD: Record the medical board verdict for the scanned candidate.
medical.intro_CERTIFICATE: Record the government physician certificate for the scanned candidate.
medical.no_mode_body: This agency has no medical mode on this station.
medical.refused_not_applicable: The application is not at the medical step.
medical.refused_forbidden: Your account may not record this.
medical.refused_invalid: The server did not accept this entry.
medical.refused_other: The server did not record it. Try again.
medical.offline_body: Nothing was recorded. Use the paper sheet and enter it when connected.
medical.physician_too_long: The name is too long (120 characters at most).

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.intro: Venue counts, this tablet's records and the fleet.
supervisor.no_venue_day: No venue day confirmed on this tablet.
supervisor.counts: Expected {{expected}}, admitted {{admitted}}, physical {{physicalCaptured}}, medical {{medicalRecorded}}, open conflicts {{openConflicts}}
supervisor.read_failed: Could not read from the server.
supervisor.sync_summary: {{total}} records: {{acknowledged}} with the server, {{waiting}} not sent, {{refused}} refused, {{conflicts}} in conflict
supervisor.fleet_no_permission: Fleet view needs the device management permission.
supervisor.manual_identity: Manual identity: the candidate is admitted at the gate with the pass and the typed national ID. A face that does not match is never a refusal.
